headword: {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}

definitions.explanation: A solar eclipse in which the Moon covers only part of the Sun's disk, so the Sun appears notched rather than fully hidden.

examples.japanese: {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A partial solar eclipse was visible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A partial solar eclipse was observed in many places today.

examples.japanese: {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: Even during a partial solar eclipse, looking directly at the sun is dangerous.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (partial) + ⟦{日食|にっしょく}→日食：06311_nisshoku⟧ (solar eclipse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to observe a partial solar eclipse
- {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧: a partial solar eclipse can be seen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}→皆既日食：29532_kaikinisshoku⟧: total eclipse — the Sun is completely hidden
- ⟦{金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}→金環日食：29534_kinkannisshoku⟧: annular eclipse — a ring of sunlight remains
